critical_code_review_comments: Module Detail route uses UUID mid (e.g. /modules/4eacbd9c711c47228641898180c80335) while modules-list row testids use the module key (welcome_to_masci, annual_refresher, ...). This is intentional and correct, but the request statement loosely said '/modules/{id}' — note for any future doc/test author: the URL path segment is the document UUID, not the key. The Open NavLink href bridges both correctly.

Dashboard KPI testids are tx-orient-kpi-certs-30 / -certs-90 / -avg-quiz (with hyphen) — not cert30/cert90/quizscore. Visual data is correct; downstream Playwright suites should standardise on the hyphenated names exposed in _orientation.jsx L119-122.

ModuleDetail intermediate state shows tx-orient-module-loading testid when API list call is in flight or mid does not match any returned id — good for tests; consider distinguishing 'module not found' (mid missing in returned list) from 'still loading' so deep-linking with a stale UUID surfaces a clear empty state instead of an infinite 'Loading…'.

All 13 axios call sites across _orientation.jsx, ExternalCarrierInvite.jsx, CertificateVerify.jsx, MasciVideoPlayer.jsx verified clean of leading /api (grep confirms). The previous regression is fixed.
